request: Create a simple Python file that intentionally fails a pytest test due to a missing dependency. Then run the test through the system and ensure the executor detects the missing dependency, installs it, retries the test, and passes. Document the full behavior.
title: Create and test Python file with missing dependency
goals: Create a Python file with a function that requires an external library not installed
Write a pytest test that fails due to the missing dependency
Run the test and detect the missing dependency
Install the missing dependency and rerun the test to ensure it passes
Document the entire process including detection, installation, and test results
constraints: Do not use any dependency management tools like poetry or pipenv
Ensure the documentation is in Markdown format
success_criteria: The initial pytest test fails due to the missing dependency
The missing dependency is correctly identified and installed
The pytest test passes after installing the dependency
The process is documented clearly in Markdown format
